result.title: Split and Bridge: Multimodal Generation via Diffusion Bridging
result.summary: Visual data are often expressed through multiple complementary modalities (e.g., images and segmentation masks), each capturing different aspects of the same underlying structure. Most existing multimodal methods adopt a top-down paradigm, learning a shared latent variable through joint training from scratch, which limits scalability. We propose Split and Bridge (SnB), a bottom-up framework for multimodal generation that couples pretrained unimodal diffusion models at sampling time. Rather than learning a unified latent space, SnB generates coherent multimodal samples by following a shared diffusion trajectory up to a split point and then branching into modality-specific trajectories guided by a bridge module. This design enables plug-and-play reuse of powerful pretrained models without joint training, making it scalable and easily adaptable. Across standard benchmarks (PolyMNIST, CelebAMask-HQ) and more complex settings (PIE-Bench++, ROCO), SnB achieves a strong balance between sample quality and coherence. We show that SnB naturally extends to downstream zero-shot tasks such as interleaved co-generation, image editing, and style coupling/decoupling. Our results demonstrate that bottom-up generation provides a practical framework that complements existing top-down multimodal approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/AhmadArrabi/SnB

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Split and Bridge（SnB）自底向上多模态生成框架：在采样阶段耦合多个预训练单模态扩散模型，先共享扩散轨迹至某分裂点，再经 bridge 模块分支为各模态轨迹，无需联合训练即可复用已有模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其共享轨迹与分裂点后分模态更新的设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据与推理状态如何共享、何时分支提供结构类比，但当前属图像生成任务，需核查分裂点机制是否有状态更新或证据筛选的可借鉴之处。
